title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hope you weren’t let down on your birthday, greg
Thankfully they lost so I go home before 11 finally.
Nothing like working 12 hours!
Have you been going to the ballpark?
Past four days yeah. But I’m definitely not going on Saturday or Sunday.
That’s what you think
Do you think TBA on Sunday is Mize?
Oh Jesus Christ now I’m worried that might be the case
Emphasized “That’s what you think”
Got my big discipline meeting coming up LFG
Won’t that be one day too early for Mize?
I got 9
Not sure if that’s enough
Honestly
Doesn’t the fact that baseball appears to be tearing apart factor into this?
Yeah, which is why you wouldn’t want to waste a full year of control on a wasted season.
He comes up to pitch, gets you to 32 games this season and then things shut down.
I’d say that’s not worth it
Yep
Maybe Norris is ready and can give you two innings.
That’s what I’m thinking
Anyway, good luck this afternoon. Lemme know how it goes
Have to imagine the Guillen bat flip is top 5 all-time *boss* bat flips
Bautista #1 obviously
But the way he flips it and shuffles looking right at him is so great
Without a doubt. The Tim Anderson one is Top 5 as well. But you know it’s good when the next batter is getting thrown at
Mikaela in love after a month
Good things come to those who wait ✨
